notes.title: Cyberscape 0.8.1
notes.content:
[u][b]Cyberscape Update 0.8.1[/b][/u]

A very small update to address a couple of bugs and a rework to damage calculations.

[b][u]Reworks[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked Player Damage Calculations

Old system had a "shield gating" mechanic that allowed the shield to soak up damage until it went down completely. Meaning an enemy with 10 Shield receiving 100 damage would only take 10 shield damage to break the shield and 0 health damage.

New system removes the shield gating completely and extra damage carries over in the health bar. Using the previous example the enemy would take 10 shield damage and 90 health damage.

Overall, this will benefit higher damage heroes the most as well as explosives. Specter's primary fire and Norman's Alt Fire should feel much better.
[/list]
[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where some achievements were not tracking properly.
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause Dronebot to not die.
[/list]

notes.title: Cyberscape Patch 0.8.0
notes.content:
[u][b]Cyberscape Patch 0.8.0[/b][/u]

[b][u]New Enemies
[/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362451/095584b5af8a8c5f0f49fd37ece5601cac765b99.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Dronebot[/b] - A sneaky and fast moving bot that is always on the move.

[*] [b]Grenadebot[/b] - Who gave this bot a grenade?

[*] [b]Shotgunbot[/b] - An aggressive bot that usually hits their target at least once

[*] [b]Shieldgenbot[/b] - Equipped with a shield generator, this bot has increased shield regeneration. When defeated the shield generator drops healing other bots shields in the radius.
[/list]

[b][u]New Items - Cooldown Items
[/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362451/8a1e190840f914dc9cab346da3d7f276d16875dd.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Preservation Matrix [/b]- Triggers when dead. Don't die and instead gain invincibility for 10 seconds. Has a 3 minute cooldown.

[*] [b]Supershot[/b] - Triggers when shooting. Fire a super powerful shot. Has a 15 second cooldown.

[*] [b]Explosive Shield[/b] - Triggers when shield breaks. Make an explosion around the player. Has a 60 second cooldown.

[*] [b]Parting Gift [/b]- Triggers when dashing. Shoot out 16 shots around the player that scales with current damage. Has a 30 second cooldown.
[/list]

New Achievements have been added to unlock the new items

[b][u]Quality of Life
[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Toggle Fire Option

[*] Reset Button for Cybernetic Enhancements
[/list]

[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the incorrect song was playing during the EVE boss fight
[*] Fixed visual bug with vending machines on Operation Ironclad (For real this time)
[/list]

notes.title: Cyberscape Patch 0.7.3
notes.content:
Small update to address a bunch of bugs recently found. A new roadmap for the game will come out soon so stay tuned for that.

[b][u]General[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new base stat - Lifesteal
[/list][list]
 [i]Lifesteal is a percentage based stat that gives health based off of current damage. Lifesteal is only active when attacking health, shields do not give lifesteal.[/i]
[/list][list]
[*] Added new item and achievement for Lifesteal
[/list]

[b][u]Enemies[/u][/b]

[u]EVE[/u]
[list]
[*] Decreased damage from 20 - 10
[/list]

[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where enemy shields would take over damage making their shields go in the negative.

[*] Fixed a visual bug on Operation Ironclad where vending machines would appear behind crates

[*] Fixed a bug where First Mission Complete would only complete at round 20 or higher

[*] Fixed a bug where [Redacted]'s DDoS sound wasn't changing with volume settings

[*] Fixed a bug where EVE wouldn't properly die

[*] Fixed a bug involving seen enemies not properly showing in the menu

[*] Fixed a bug where some achievements would not properly unlock heroes or maps

[*] Fixed a bug where volume sliders would reset after starting a game
[/list]

notes.title: Cyberscape Update 0.7.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This is a quick update to address the difficulty in the early game. These changes should make the game feel a lot better. These changes will be monitored and if any need to be reverted or more added they will be addressed at a later point.

[u][b]Heroes[/b][/u]

[u]Norman[/u]
[list]
[*] Increased dash length from 0.7 - 1
[*] Increased dash speed from 6 - 6.5
[*] Increased base damage from 20 - 25
[*] Increased base health from 200 - 250
[/list]

[u][b]Enemies[/b][/u]

[u]Swordbot[/u]
[list]
[*] Decreased speed from 4 - 3.5
[*] Decreased damage from 30 - 15
[/list]

[u]Riflebot[/u]
[list]
[*] Decreased damage from 10 - 8
[*] Decreased firerate from 5 - 4
[*] Riflebots don't spawn until round 9
[/list]

[u]Machinegunbot[/u]
[list]
[*] Decreased damage from 15 - 10
[*] Decreased firerate from 12 - 10
[/list]

[b][u]Economy[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the prices of most doors on all maps. 
 [i]Most doors cost 250 less than previously some were reduced more and some went unchanged[/i]
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed an audio issue with Norman grenade explosions
[*] Fixed a bug that caused bots to randomly stand still
[/list]


Any and all feedback is appreciated have fun with the easier early game and let us know what you think.

notes.title: Cyberscape Update 0.7.0
notes.content:
[b][u]Cyberscape Update 0.7.0[/u][/b]

[b][u]New Map - Dreadnought[/u][/b]
[i]After discovering the location of the bots Dreadnought sneak on board and destroy it. But beware of the DREAD bots and be on the lookout for DRACO as they will do everything they can to stop you.[/i]

[b][u]New Boss - DRACO[/u][/b]
[i]The Dreadnought Repair And Cloning Operative is a menacing bot with two bot buddies that guard them. DRACO has the ability to repair and upgrade the buddies and clone themselves. Be prepared for a fight because they are the toughest boss yet.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362451/858dff0808cd257168e78b9f42e3eab07ac0558d.gif[/img]

[b][u]Additions[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Added a tutorial

 [i]A small tutorial that showcases the basics of Cyberscape to help new or confused players.[/i]
 [/list]
[list]
[*] Added General Stats

[i]The general stats section now functions and contains a bunch of small fun stats that track your Cyberscape progress.[/i]
[/list]


[b][u]Quality of Life[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Added item name and description in the item choice menu
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added bot catch up mechanic 

[i]This mechanic triggers when bots are really far away from the player. Bots will respawn closer to the player. This should help those situations where the last bot in the round is lost across the map.[/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*] Updated music for all bosses
[/list]

[b][u]Balancing[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] All basic units give +25 more credits

[*] Easy mode increases credits per kill by 50%
[/list]

[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the interact text for doors, vending machines, power switches etc.
[*] Fixed Phantom reload visual bug
[*] Fixed Demobot visual bug
[*] Fixed Cybernetic Enhancements that chance health and shield from not applying until the player takes damage
[*] Fixed an issue where using a dash ability at a specific time would prevent a bot from spawning
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the update this one was a lot of fun to make. DRACO is a lot of fun to fight but be prepared they are really tough. As always any and all feedback is appreciated so give me your thoughts on the update.

notes.title: Cyberscape Update 0.6.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[u][b]Cyberscape Update 0.6.0[/b][/u]

[u][b]New Hero - Phantom[/b][/u]
[i]Introducing the stealthiest member to Cyberscape, Phantom. They are a cybernetically enhanced ninja that uses shurikens and a sword.[/i]
[b]Primary Fire - Shuriken[/b]
[list]
[*] Throw slow but high damage shurikens at bots.
[/list]
[b]Alt Fire - Sword[/b]
[list]
[*] When bots are too close pull out your sword and cut them down.
[/list]
[b]Ability 1 - Deflect[/b]
[list]
[*] Deflect incoming bullets back at the bots and even stun bots in the way.
[/list]
[b]Ability 2 - Flash Bomb[/b]
[list]
[*] Throw a flash bomb that deals damage and stuns bots on impact
[/list]
[b]Dash - Stealth Cloak[/b]
[list]
[*] Thanks to the suit become completely invisible and confuse the bots, while cloaked sword does more damage.
[/list]
[b]Passive[/b] - Deal 30% more melee damage to stunned or confused targets

Added 3 hero items for Phantom to earn

[u][b]Operation Ironclad Rework[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Reworked the round system to match The Lab's
[*] Bots appear differently on the map
[*] Main Quest Added
[list]
[*] Discover the secret plans the bots are up to, but be careful, T.A.N.K. won't let you find out without a fight.
[/list]
[/list][u][b]Additions[/b][/u]
Added 7 new achievements


[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Changed the medkit sprite
[list]
[*]  [i]Reasons...[/i]
[/list]
[*] Changed the "Whos the Boss Now" achievement to no longer reward Operation Ironclad
[list]
[*] [i]There is a new and much easier achievement to unlock the map[/i]
[/list]
[*] Changed the song for T.A.N.K.

[*] Changed the extraction song for The Lab
[/list]

[b][u]Quality of Life[/u][/b]
Added audio volume settings

[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a visual bug with the bot counter
[*] Fixed a bug that would not allow bots to spawn
[*] Fixed a bug on Operation Ironclad where the end of game exp bar would not show
[*] Fixed a bug on Operation Ironclad where extraction was not working
[/list]

Hope everyone enjoys Phantom. They have the most fun hero items in my opinion. Let us know what you think of the main quest for Operation Ironclad and as always any and all feedback is appreciated.

notes.title: Going Forward: Cyberscape Roadmap
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone that is supporting Cyberscape in Early Access. Here's a glimpse into the future of Cyberscape:

1. Introducing a New Hero: The Stealthy Melee Ninja!
Prepare to welcome a new hero to the Cyberscape universe – a master of stealth, agility, and close-quarters combat. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362451/c91667b72d92a7bd9949aba229e5758c7b37e648.png[/img]

2. New Map Dreadnought!
A new map will be arriving that will take place on a really big Dreadnaught ship. We can't add a new map without a new boss. We won't say too much but their name is D.R.A.C.O.

3. Operation Ironclad: The Ultimate Main Quest!
The main quest for Operation Ironclad. Uncover the bots secrets but be careful as the almighty T.A.N.K won't make it easy for you.

4. New Items and achievements
We will regularly update the game with new items and achievements some sneak peaks are Ricochet Rounds, Exploding Bullets, and Life Steal Rounds.


Join Us in Shaping Cyberscape's Future!

How You Can Contribute:
Share Your Thoughts: Have ideas or suggestions? We want to hear them! Your thoughts on gameplay mechanics, balance adjustments, or new features are much appreciated.

Thank you for being a part of the Cyberscape community. Let's shape the future of Cyberscape together!

notes.title: Cyberscape Alpha Playtest Goals
notes.content:
The goals of this playtest is to get as much feedback as possible about all aspects of the game. Mainly focusing on the following...

- General gameplay feel
- Heroes and how they feel and play
- Enemies and rounds 
- Items and their balance with the game
- Overall balance with economy
- Achievements, are they do easy/hard/annoying
- Audio, is there sounds that should or should not exist?

Feedback and be on the steam forums or through the discord here https://discord.gg/TfxgA2Tw8H

Thanks to everyone that puts any amount of time in playing Cyberscape and I hope everyone has fun!
